wiki.summary: First leaked on May 14, 2026, “Make Them Remember” was originally thought to be named “1am in Albany”. The leak also featured an extended verse which was not played in Episode 4 of his ICEMAN livestream series on YouTube. Make Them Remember is a one-verse song featuring themes related to betrayal and fake loyalty as well as his identity and isolation. Read more on Last.fm.
